title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
lede: Daydream launched Daydream Agent, a fashion shopping agent that remembers a shopper's style, fit and budget, runs virtual try-ons and can finish a purchase with one-click checkout.

points: Shoppers upload one photo and the agent reuses it to try on any saved item.
It watches for sales and new brand drops, and sends weekly trend updates.
Connecting a closet and a calendar lets it build outfits around owned clothes and upcoming events.
It pulls live price and stock data from a catalog of more than 10,000 brands, using fine-tuned OpenAI, Gemini and Claude models alongside its own.
A Stylist in Residence, Francesca Salih, supplies styling content to the fashion knowledge base the agent draws on.

sections.text: It is a clear template for a vertical agent: general models fine-tuned and grounded in live catalog data, with a human-curated domain knowledge base steering the output.
